text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph structure with clear opening, reasons, counterpoint, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay shows stronger overall structure and paragraphing to develop its argument in an orderly way."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"The first reason,\" \"The second reason,\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay connects ideas more deliberately with signposting that guides the reader through the response."},{"evidence":"more specific examples about cousins, Liberty University, the AirForce, and the FBI","quality":"development","description":"The essay supports its claims with fuller, more concrete elaboration rather than brief general statements."},{"evidence":"phrases such as \"most likely to know what they want in life\" and \"a good job that pays very well\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay expands its points with more explanation of consequences and benefits."},{"evidence":"sentences like \"I could not be any prouder of him\" and \"I want to feel like i'm on top of the world\"","quality":"voice","description":"The essay has a stronger personal presence and sense of engagement with the topic."},{"evidence":"uses academic and topic-specific wording like \"internships,\" \"shadowing opportunities,\" and \"occupations\"","quality":"vocabulary range","description":"The essay uses a broader and more precise set of words appropriate to the argument."},{"evidence":"multiple sentence forms including complex sentences and quoted dialogue","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay shows more control over varied sentence structures than the simpler essay."}]}
